frame_note: Frame 0.66 m wide: the suspension-envelope checks showed the steered front wheel reaching 0.76 m rails at full lock with bump or roll (cars of the period narrowed the frame for lock).
steering_note: Steering box beside the engine (x 2.20) with the column raked back through the dash; pitman and drag arms point back, joined by a transverse drag link at the front axle's roll-axis height (0.455 m). First layout (Velo-style diagonal link 0.10 m below the roll axis) gave up to 7.7 deg roll steer and the car spun at 16 m/s with the column held straight; locking the axle's roll removed it.
